name: Get You Online
description: A fast, simple starter site built from a clean template to get your business name, services, and contact info live right away.
features: Your text, photos, and contact info added
pageIntro: Getting online doesn't have to be complicated or expensive. Using a clean, ready-made template, I'll set up a simple starter site with the essentials every new business needs: who you are, what you do, and how people can reach you.
whoItsFor: Brand-new businesses, side hustles, and solo operators who just need a clean, credible home on the web right away—without spending a lot of time or money upfront.

details.heading: What's on the page
details.text: A clear headline and intro, a brief overview of what you offer, a short about blurb, and your contact details or opening hours. All arranged in a clean, ready-made layout that fits your business.

details.heading: How it works
details.text:
Send over your logo, photos, and basic business details. I'll plug everything into a clean template

You'll usually be online in about a 2-3 days.
